scope: Diagnostic reconstruction from DOM frame-ID observations, not a screen recording, actual app GIF export, mobile-device benchmark or frame-rate guarantee.
artwork: Both panels share the exact same native atlas frames. Uniform crop, scale, matte and shared 256-color palette are presentation only; no pose retouching or interpolation.

comparisons.alignment: Earliest before sample with a matching after ID and a full observed window; no speed/phase retiming.

atlas.provenance: Actual previously downloaded composed CharacterPack; shared by both panels.

presentation.quantization: Latest observed drawing at each grid point; each event is shown less than 20ms late. No 10ms frames, which GIF viewers may clamp.
